transcript.text: Bosch HBS534BS0B oven displaying E011 and won't let me do anything. Beeping. Help!

I can't confirm what E011 means on your model, so I'll go by what it is doing. From what you have described, the most likely cause is main control PCB / programmer. Is it completely dead (no display, no light), or does the display work but the oven won't heat?

Display works, it lights up and the clock showed before the code came up. Just can't select anything. Oven's not been used since, it started after I wiped the panel with a wet cloth and spray about an hour ago.
From what you have described, the most likely cause is display / user interface. Next: After a power cut set the clock/timer to MANUAL before condemning the board. Let me know what you find.
I can't do that, the panel won't accept any input at all and it just keeps beeping with E011 showing. There hasn't been a power cut either. Anything else I can try?
Could you tell me a bit more about what it is doing, and when it happens?

It shows E011 and beeps every so often, and none of the touch buttons respond. It started about an hour ago, straight after I wiped the panel with a damp cloth and multi-surface spray. No smells, and it's never had a fault before.
From what you have checked, this needs an appliance engineer to look at it: the next steps are beyond the checks that are safe to do yourself.
